description: Terms and path allowlist for docs/stale_check.py. Each term is a heuristic: a hit means a file states a retired system as current authority, an old contact point, or leftover placeholder text, and needs a human look. Allowlisted paths are historical evidence or migration records that are expected to keep the words.
